title: Peterloo Massacre
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Peterloo Massacre", at revision 1380495787, opens: "The Peterloo Massacre took place at St Peter's Field, Manchester, England, on Monday 16 August 1819. An estimated eighteen people were killed and 400–700 were injured when the cavalry of the Yeomanry charged into a crowd of around 60,000 people who had gathered to demand the reform of parliamentary representation." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q876357, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "event on 16 August 1819 in Manchester, England, when cavalry charged into a crowd of ca. 60 000 people demanding parliamentary representation reform, killing 18 and injuring hundreds". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
